final: WITH code_sums AS (SELECT positionText AS code, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(laps, '\N'), '') AS INTEGER)) AS lap_sum FROM results GROUP BY positionText), lap_total AS (SELECT SUM(lap_sum) AS total FROM code_sums), divisions AS (SELECT c.code, c.lap_sum, 1.0 * c.lap_sum / t.total AS division FROM code_sums AS c JOIN lap_total AS t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), division_average AS (SELECT AVG(division) AS mean_division FROM divisions), kept AS (SELECT d.lap_sum, d.division, d.division - a.mean_division AS difference FROM divisions AS d JOIN division_average AS a ON a.mean_division IS NOT NULL WHERE d.division > a.mean_division) SELECT SUM(lap_sum), AVG(division), AVG(difference) FROM kept
